name: Gästehaus Radetzky
beschreibung:
Enjoying a sunny and peaceful setting in Koessen, Gaestehaus Radetzky welcomes visitors with comfortable guestrooms and captivating views of the Kaiser mountains.

Scenic hiking routes, cross-country tracks, and the Unterberg cable cars in Koessen are conveniently close.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Radetzky in Koessen features cosy living comfort and alpine quietude in Kaiserwinkl.
